title: SZQ-3, a Novel Synthetic Chromone-Maleimide Hybrid Targeting NF-kappaB, Prevents Postmenopausal Osteoporosis by Modulating Mitochondrial Function in Bone Cells.
authors: Zhang, Yichi; Jiang, Tianle; Zhou, Runqi; Tong, Wen; Ye, Huayu; Tu, Junhao; Yi, Mengjia; Ma, Xinyi; Chen, Shuomin; Ping, Yifan; Li, Bin; Chen, Yang; Song, Zengqiang; Mao, Yixin; Huang, Shengbin; Zhao, Shufan
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究合成化合物SZQ-3通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路防治骨质疏松，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物药理与骨细胞功能，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The therapeutic utility of current anti-osteoporotic drugs is limited owing to adverse effects and safety concerns, highlighting the urgent need for safer and more effective alternatives. SZQ-3, a chromone-maleimide hybrid, exhibits anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, the efficacy of SZQ-3 against osteoporosis and the underlying mechanisms remain unexplored. In the study, we assessed the protective effects of SZQ-3 on osteoblasts and inhibitory effects on osteoclast differentiation, and its ability to prevent PMOP progression. In vitro, osteoblast apoptosis and osteoclast differentiation were evaluated using H(2)O(2)-stimulated MC3T3-E1 cells and RANKL-induced RAW264.7 cells, respectively. RNA sequencing, molecular docking, and pathway analyses were employed to elucidate mechanisms. In vivo efficacy and safety were assessed in an ovariectomy-induced estrogen deficiency-related bone loss mouse model. Our results indicated that SZQ-3 suppressed H(2)O(2)-induced osteoblast apoptosis and inhibited receptor activator of nuclear factor-kappa B ligand (RANKL)-stimulated osteoclast differentiation. Transciptomic analysis identified nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling as a key regulatory pathway. Molecular docking revealed a strong binding affinity of SZQ-3 to NF-kappaB, involving specific hydrogen bond interactions. SZQ-3 attenuated H(2)O(2)- and RANKL-induced activation of the NF-kappaB pathway by reducing phosphorylation and impeding nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB, stabilizing mitochondrial function. In ovariectomized mice, SZQ-3 exhibited significant anti-osteoporotic efficacy with an excellent safety profile. These findings suggest SZQ-3 is a potent NF-kappaB inhibitor and a strong dual-action therapeutic agent against osteoporosis and lay the groundwork for future clinical development.
abstract_zh: 目前抗骨质疏松药物的治疗效用因不良反应和安全性问题而受限，凸显了对更安全有效替代方案的迫切需求。SZQ-3是一种色酮-马来酰亚胺杂合物，具有抗炎和抗氧化特性。然而，SZQ-3对抗骨质疏松的疗效及其潜在机制尚未被探索。在本研究中，我们评估了SZQ-3对成骨细胞的保护作用、对破骨细胞分化的抑制作用，以及其阻止PMOP进展的能力。在体外实验中，分别使用H(2)O(2)刺激的MC3T3-E1细胞和RANKL诱导的RAW264.7细胞评估成骨细胞凋亡和破骨细胞分化。采用RNA测序、分子对接和通路分析来阐明机制。在卵巢切除诱导的雌激素缺乏相关骨丢失小鼠模型中评估了体内疗效和安全性。我们的结果表明，SZQ-3抑制了H(2)O(2)诱导的成骨细胞凋亡，并抑制了核因子κB受体活化因子配体（RANKL）刺激的破骨细胞分化。转录组分析确定核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路为关键调控通路。分子对接揭示SZQ-3与NF-kappaB具有强结合亲和力，涉及特异性氢键相互作用。SZQ-3通过减少NF-kappaB的磷酸化和阻碍其核转位，稳定线粒体功能，从而减弱H(2)O(2)和RANKL诱导的NF-kappaB通路激活。在卵巢切除小鼠中，SZQ-3表现出显著的抗骨质疏松疗效和优异的安全性。这些发现表明，SZQ-3是一种强效NF-kappaB抑制剂，也是针对骨质疏松的强效双重作用治疗剂，为未来的临床开发奠定了基础。
